title: Agents cannot switch notifications off per department
label: MISSING vs ZOHO
date: TAVI 9 Nov 2026 (live) · Zoho: help article (live Zoho Desk did not load on this network)
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · Avatar › My Notifications (/settings/notifications/preferences)

panels.caption: TAVI: My Notifications has channels and per-signal choices only (1); there is no list of departments to switch off.
Zoho Desk help, Feeds › Notification preferences: agents in several departments can turn off notifications from a department (1).

rows: Each agent can disable notifications from departments they rarely work in.
Not possible: only channels (In-app, Email, WhatsApp, SMS) and signal types can be turned off, for all departments at once.
